title: Power and Sample Size for 2-Level Factorial (full or fractional) Design
nFactorsHelp: The number of experimental factors in the design.
runsPerRep: Number of corner points (i.e., number of runs per replicate)
runsPerRepHelp: For a FULL factorial: 2^k (e.g., 8 for 3 factors, 16 for 4 factors). For a FRACTIONAL factorial: the actual run count of the base design (e.g., 8 for a 2^(5-2) design)
lblSolveFor: Solve For (leave only one blank to calculate i.e., Replicates, Effect, Power, or Center points per block)
nReplicatesHelp: Number of times the full set of corner points is repeated. Enter a positive integer to compute power, or leave blank to solve for the minimum replicates needed to achieve the target power.
effectHelp: The minimum difference between the high and low level means that you want the design to reliably detect. This is the full contrast (high − low), NOT the regression coefficient. Note: the regression coefficient in a coded model = δ / 2.
targetPowerHelp: The probability of correctly detecting the effect if it truly exists. Enter a value between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.90 for 90% power). Leave blank to compute achieved power given the other three quantities.
sigmaHelp: Always required — sigma cannot be solved for. Estimate of the standard deviation of a single observation at replicated runs. Use the square root of the Mean Square Error from a prior experiment, or a process knowledge estimate.
alphaHelp: Type I error rate — the maximum acceptable probability of declaring a false effect significant. Default is 0.05.
nCpPerBlockHelp: Number of center point runs added to each block. Center points add error df, improving power. Default 0 = no center points. Leave BLANK to solve for the minimum center points per block needed to achieve the target power (requires Replicates, Effect, and Power all to be entered).
nBlocksHelp: Number of blocks in the design. Default 1 = no blocking. Must divide evenly into (corner points × replicates).
includeCpTermChk: Include center-point curvature term in model
includeCpTermHelp: When center points are present, checking this includes the curvature term in the model, which costs 1 df. Recommended when center points > 0
termsOmitted: Number of terms omitted from model
termsOmittedHelp: Number of highest-order interaction terms pooled into the error term. Required > 0 when replicates = 1 and no center points (otherwise df_error = 0 and power cannot be computed). For unreplicated 2^3: omit 1 (the 3-way). For unreplicated 2^4: omit 5 (four 3-ways + one 4-way).
showTableChk: Show power table across replicates 1 to max
showPowerCurvePlotChk: Show power curve plot (Power vs Effect)
lbl_design_note: For a full 2^k factorial, corner points = 2^k. For a fractional 2^(k-p) factorial, corner points = actual run count of the base design (e.g., 8 for 2^(5-2)).
lbl_solve_note: If all four are filled, achieved power is computed and the entered power is used only as the reference line on the plot. Sigma is always required above.
lbl_terms_note: For unreplicated designs with no center points, you must omit at least one term to obtain error degrees of freedom. Typical choices: omit highest-order interactions assumed negligible.
maxCpForSearch: Maximum center points per block to search (will be used when Center points field is left blank)

help.title: Power and Sample Size for 2-Level Factorial Design
help.body:
Description
Computes power, required replicates, or minimum detectable effect for any 2-level factorial design — full factorial (2^k), fractional factorial (2^(k-p)), with or without center points, with or without blocking.

Always Required (not solvable)
  • Sigma (σ): Standard deviation of observations at replicated runs. Always required — cannot be solved for.
  • Alpha (α): Significance level (default 0.05). Always required.
The Four Solvable Quantities — leave ONE blank to solve for it
  • Replicates (n): Times the corner point runs are repeated. Leave blank → minimum replicates to achieve target power.
  • Effect (δ): High-minus-low mean difference. Leave blank → minimum detectable effect.
  • Power: Probability of detecting the effect. Leave blank → achieved power.
  • Center points per block: Leave blank → minimum center points per block to achieve target power (4th solvable quantity). Requires replicates, effect, and power all to be provided.
Statistical Method
Power is computed from the non-central F distribution with 1 numerator df:
  • Non-centrality parameter: λ = r × n × δ² / (4σ²)
  • df_error = total observations − parameters estimated
  • Power = P(F(1, df_error, λ) > F_crit(α))
where r = corner points per replicate, n = replicates.

Corner Points (runs per replicate)
  • Full factorial 2^k: enter 2^k (e.g., 8 for k=3, 16 for k=4)
  • Fractional factorial 2^(k-p): enter actual run count of base design (e.g., 8 for a 2^(5-2) design with 5 factors)
Terms Omitted
For unreplicated designs with no center points, all df are consumed by model parameters and df_error = 0. To obtain error df, specify the number of highest-order interaction terms assumed negligible and pooled into error. Example: unreplicated 2^3 full factorial → omit 1 (the 3-way interaction).

Output
  • Summary table: replicates, effect, power, total runs, df_error
  • Power table: power for each replicate count from 1 to max
  • Power curve plot with reference line at target power

3 factors, 8 corner points, Effect = 0.001, Sigma = 0.0005, Alpha = 0.03, 0 center points, target power = 0.90 → Replicates = 3, Actual power = 0.9906.
